Experience: 4+ Years
 Role: QA Automation Engineer
 Location: Hyderabad
 Interview -F2F
 Employment Type: Full-Time(Unison)
 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for an experienced Automation Tester with strong knowledge of automation testing frameworks, Selenium, Java, API testing and manual testing. The candidate should have experience in designing, developing and executing automation test scripts to ensure application quality.
 Key Responsibilities: 

• Design, develop and maintain automation test scripts.

• Work on Selenium WebDriver using Java.

• Develop and maintain automation frameworks.

• Perform functional, regression and integration testing.

• Perform API testing using REST Assured or Postman.

• Identify, report and track defects using JIRA.

• Collaborate with developers and QA teams.

• Participate in test planning, test case design and execution.

• Integrate automation scripts into CI/CD pipelines.

 Mandatory Skills: 

• Selenium WebDriver

• Core Java

• Automation Testing

• TestNG / JUnit

• API Testing – REST Assured / Postman

• SQL

• JIRA

• Regression Testing
